Before you grab your seat

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s an educational class about everyday nutrition. It isn’t medical advice and doesn’t replace an individual assessment with your own health professional.

Who is it for?

Anyone who wants a clearer, evidence-based approach to everyday eating, whether you’re training for an event or packing school lunches.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, learn the habits, and decide afterwards if you want 1:1 support.

Script 1 · “The trend check”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’m a sports dietitian. Here are the gut health trends I’d skip.”

Body

“A lot of what you see online is a product to buy. The habits with the best evidence are simpler: more variety, enough fibre, and meals you can actually repeat on a busy week.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera in your kitchen. End card: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “The lunchbox”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This is the easiest place to add more plants to your week.”

Body

“It’s the lunchbox. A handful of chickpeas, a few seeds, leftover roast veg. Three small swaps and you’ve added variety without cooking a single extra meal.”

CTA

“In Bridge the Gaps I’ll show you the rest. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: packing a lunchbox on the bench, voiceover, each swap labelled on screen.

Script 3 · “The athlete’s plate”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What I teach endurance athletes about food works for everyone.”

Body

“Athletes can’t afford to guess. They plan the plate around the day ahead: energy, protein, colour. You don’t need to run a marathon to eat like you have a plan.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a plate split into three sections with labels.

Then meals you can actually repeat on a busy week.

No overhaul. No extremes. Just the gaps, bridged.
